intro.text: A priest in the God King's palace in T'Telir.
A priest in the God King's palace, ordered to help get Siri and Susebron to safety when the palace is attacked.

items.text: As the palace is stormed, High Priest Treledees orders Gendren to take half the loyal soldiers left and escort Siri and Susebron out. When Siri exposes Bluefingers, who was to guide them to the docks, Gendren's group stays with Treledees and tries another way out, but Lifeless catch them and kill Gendren along with Treledees and the other priests.
